highlights.title: Blue Ink: read like a marked-up notebook
highlights.description: Cool white paper, fountain-pen blue, and pencil-drawn lines give everything from the library to the reader a hand-drawn look, while book text stays clean.

highlights.title: Distillation cards flip over
highlights.description: Turning an annotation into a distillation flips the card, with a paper sound when you publish. Stacked cards fan out, and switching moves only the card you bring forward.

highlights.title: A steadier annotation rail
highlights.description: In dense PDFs, cards glide in and out and stay with the text as you scroll instead of jumping or flickering. Annotations at the top show as soon as a PDF opens.

highlights.title: Less memory for big books, faster imports
highlights.description: Large PDFs use about a third less memory while opening and scrolling, older EPUB data is slimmed down, and batch ebook imports take about half the time.

highlights.title: Task models follow the default model
highlights.description: Tasks without their own model show "Inherit default model" and switch when you change the default. Assistants also work when only a default model is set.
